{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders, excluding QA orders
target_df = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
                (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Print the number of valid orders and the mean revenue
print(f'Number of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {len(target_df)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {target_df["revenue_clean"].mean():.2f} USD')"}
